$comment: Pictures' alt text, read by VoiceOver (GAME_DESIGN 11.9, 18.3). The cover's own line; and from S6 the trail pictures' parts (web/js/gfx/alt.js): a scene's line or a base's, then each skyline's, the sprite's and the hour's (day adds none), each a whole sentence, joined in that order, so every drawable place is described with no line of its own (decision 69), and the same words are the picture's Look where a tap hits no hotspot. Lint P15 holds every drawable place's parts to their lines. Working words; status comes from approved.json.

alt.cover_high_divide_dusk.text: The High Divide at dusk. Across the Hoh valley, Mount Olympus glows pink in the last light, under the first stars. A hiker in a rust jacket walks the crest trail among subalpine firs and pink heather.
alt.cover_high_divide_dusk.ctx: VoiceOver's description of the cover on the title page (off main: there the cover is decoration beside the name; it returns as the loading art's in B002)

alt.base.lake_basin.text: A mountain lake ringed with firs, a meadow on its near shore.
alt.base.lake_basin.ctx: The lake-basin base's description (VoiceOver; and the Look where a tap hits no hotspot): every lake place drawn from it starts with it

alt.base.meadow.text: A subalpine meadow of heather and grass, with firs at its edges.
alt.base.meadow.ctx: The meadow base's description: every meadow and crest place drawn from it starts with it

alt.skyline.deer_lake_ridge.text: A forested ridge rises behind the lake.
alt.skyline.deer_lake_ridge.ctx: Deer Lake's ridge skyline, after its base's sentence

alt.skyline.olympus_from_divide.text: Across the Hoh valley stands Mount Olympus, white with glaciers.
alt.skyline.olympus_from_divide.ctx: Mount Olympus across the Hoh valley, the crest places' skyline, after its base's sentence

alt.scene.seven_lakes_basin_rim.text: From the rim, the Seven Lakes Basin below: blue lakes in pale rock and heather, Bogachiel Peak above, a stone staircase dropping into it.
alt.scene.seven_lakes_basin_rim.ctx: The rim's hand-drawn scene, looking down into the basin

alt.sprite.hiker.text: A hiker in a rust jacket stands on the trail.
alt.sprite.hiker.ctx: The hiker sprite, after the place's sentences, in every trail picture

alt.hour.dusk.ctx: The hour, last, at dusk (day adds none)

alt.hour.blue.text: Blue hour, the first stars out.
alt.hour.blue.ctx: The hour, last, at blue hour
